responsibility: Defines the infer module’s relation layer by re-exporting generic relation traits and wiring together the concrete relation implementations for generalization, higher-ranked handling, lattice operations, and type relating.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the relation-layer facade within inference. It mainly reexports generic relate APIs and assembles the concrete relation submodules (`combine`, `generalize`, `higher_ranked`, `lattice`, `type_relating`), unlike the other same-named inference modules that own mutable inference state or solve a specific class of constraints.
